bullets.text: Within a supervised capstone team, ran a supplied Python notebook to load provided company report records and edited simple filters and loops with step-by-step guidance.

Under supervision, executed and inspected supplied scikit-learn notebook procedures that ranked company report excerpts using TF-IDF similarity for provided queries, then checked retrieved documents against a small judged query set.
Executed and inspected supplied pandas and Matplotlib notebook procedures to clean metadata tables using provided steps, plot record counts, and inspect missing-value summaries with guidance.
As part of a supervised research team, wrote Python functions to parse provided research abstract records and used unittest to test transformations on hand-checked input examples.

Under supervision, compared TF-IDF and pretrained sentence-embedding retrieval of research abstracts on held-out judged queries using scikit-learn and sentence-transformers; examined recall at fixed cutoffs and grouped retrieval errors by query type.
Cleaned supplied bibliographic metadata tables using provided steps in pandas, then plotted record counts with Matplotlib and inspected missing-value summaries with guidance.
As part of a supervised research team, implemented reusable Python modules for the recorded workflow and wrote pytest regression tests for malformed and edge-case inputs.
Under supervision, applied a documented topic dictionary to provided news summary samples using NLTK and checked dictionary matches against manually reviewed examples.
Cleaned supplied publication metadata tables using provided steps in pandas, then plotted record counts with Matplotlib and inspected missing-value summaries with guidance.
